columns.name: category_id
columns.defaultConstraints: REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_writer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_version" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_system_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system_default" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_writer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_version" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "status_before_archive" TEXT NULL, "is_all_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_all_day" IN (0, 1)), "plan_date" TEXT NULL, "start_minute" INTEGER NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "end_minute" INTEGER NULL, "time_zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recurrence_rule" TEXT NULL, "recurrence_ex_dates" TEXT NULL, "split_from_task_id" TEXT NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stages" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_writer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_version" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_offset_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "duration_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "checklist_items" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_writer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_version" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_done" IN (0, 1)), "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "occurrence_overrides" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_writer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_version" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurrence_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "title_override" TEXT NULL, "note_override" TEXT NULL, "plan_date_override" TEXT NULL, "start_minute_override" INTEGER NULL, "end_date_override" TEXT NULL, "end_minute_override" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stage_occurrence_states" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_writer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_version" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "stage_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stages (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurrence_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_writer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_version" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "absolute_date" TEXT NULL, "absolute_minute" INTEGER NULL, "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_writer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_version" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_tags" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_writer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_version" TEXT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_writer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_version" TEXT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_notifications" ("os_notification_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reminder_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurrence_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "fire_at_instant" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("os_notification_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "change_log" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL);
